scope: Use six non-Zijin metals peers to estimate a causal intraday opportunity score, then add an observable regime-quality score on Zijin. This experiment never changes Smart-T V4, alerts, factor registry, or shadow pool.

dataSplit.configurationSelection: 2022-2023 history trains; 2024 is the sole configuration-selection validation period.
dataSplit.forwardValidation: 2025 is evaluated only after the selected configuration is frozen.
dataSplit.finalAudit: 2026-01-01 through the final supplied minute is evaluated only after the selected configuration is frozen.

causality.futureData: Future bars are used only by the pre-existing outcome label.
